benefactive_grades.rule: Under 6.4.68 the optional e applies in the appropriate ārdhadhātuka blessing to an ā-final root beginning with a consonant cluster outside the preceding ghu/mā/sthā group.
benefactive_grades.simple_onset: yā and vā keep ā; yāyāt and vāyāt.
benefactive_grades.cluster_onset: drā and psā license dreyāt/drāyāt and pseyāt/psāyāt throughout all nine cells.
benefactive_grades.scope: Neither simple future nor ordinary optative inherits these e alternants.

same_slot_ordinary_optative_and_blessing.third_dual: yāyātām versus yāyāstām, before adding the preverbs.

future: The four roots retain their own consonants and take ā before future t/s. Ni before the conditional augment gives nya.
